candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether breadth weakness or recovery persisted and how it aligned with price moves, helping distinguish a transient pullback from broader participation deterioration. Current breadth observations are proxy snapshots, often use changing constituent sets, and do not supply a comparable historical sequence.
candidates.evidence_reference: W41/W40/W39 reviews and daily director outputs repeatedly note that quantitative breadth sequences are absent, proxy-only, or not comparable across captures.
candidates.metric_name: Fixed-universe breadth observations with constituent membership and observation timestamps
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without a timestamped history using a recorded, consistent universe, persistence and lead-lag relative to drawdowns cannot be assessed; endpoint snapshots may misrepresent the path.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether mixed BTC and ETH fund flows persisted, reversed, or diverged during the reviewed price and breadth changes. Existing analyses commonly have only one settled session or weekly totals that cannot be aligned to within-period deterioration.
candidates.evidence_reference: W41/W40/W39 and daily outputs repeatedly identify missing settled ETF sequences, single-session observations, or absent flow timing and direction.
candidates.metric_name: Settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows by session, with settlement dates and reported units
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse settled observations prevent assessment of flow persistence and sequence relative to price weakness or recovery; missing sessions cannot be inferred from isolated totals.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether spot taker activity and order-book depth deterioration persisted or improved around the reviewed price moves, rather than relying on brief snapshots that may reflect the same transient episode.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily outputs repeatedly describe spot microstructure as brief, mixed snapshots and state that persistence is unknown; weekly reviews also flag missing liquidity sequence evidence.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped spot taker quote imbalance and depth imbalance observations by asset and venue
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without prior-day history and aligned timestamps, the analyses cannot determine whether spot participation or liquidity changes preceded, accompanied, or followed price weakness.
